title: a relationship written after a fault stays inside its package
note: FOUND 2026-09-03, FIXED the same day. Re-homing skipped every relationship, so an `import`, `alias`, `dependency` or forward-source `subset` that error recovery pushed out of its package was never brought back: it became a ROOT, and the file serialized with `import Q::*;` AFTER the closing brace of the package it scopes — which silently changes name resolution for everything inside. `rootsSurvive` cannot see this (P survives either way); only `rootsExact` can.
